name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The flagship asset is a large-scale open-pit silver-gold deposit that has received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment incentive regime, with a feasibility study and construction decision targeted for the second half of 2026. The company is transitioning from advanced explorer to developer stage.
